Actual CSPICE rejects zero normal. Require SPICE(ZEROVECTOR).

routines.edgeAssessment: Check zero constant, sign reversal, scale, distinct points, complete normal and constant, and IEEE overflow from a finite point.
routines.errorAssessment: A zero normal signals SPICE(ZEROVECTOR); malformed tuple inputs fail adapter representation validation.
routines.fixtureRationale: Kernel-independent static vectors, planes and scalar distances authored for this batch. The IEEE and boundary probes construct all inputs numerically and require no downloaded fixture or scientific kernel.
routines.cleanup: Every public focused call disposes its client. Native operations use local output storage under the existing lock, and WASM releases every acquired temporary on success, failed acquisition or toolkit error. The shared error path captures and resets CSPICE diagnostics.
routines.tolerance: The existing registered comparator compares full numeric outputs with its unchanged 1e-12 absolute-or-relative tolerance. Flags and multiplicities are exact. Focused inverse and IEEE tests compare each finite component using a 3e-15 relative bound (zero exactly), and distinguish NaN and both infinity signs exactly. Ordinary oblique round trips use 12-decimal-place absolute comparisons.
